title: Binding and thermodynamic study of thalidomide with calf thymus DNA: Spectroscopic and computational approaches.
authors: Yasmeen, Shama; Qais, Faizan Abul; Rana, Manish; Islam, Asimul; Rahisuddin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱与计算手段研究沙利度胺与小牛胸腺DNA的小沟结合，属于小分子-DNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，但分子对接与MD方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The thalidomide-DNA interactions have been investigated in detail by numerous biophysical techniques such as UV-vis, dye displacement assay, viscosity, cyclic voltammetry, circular dichroism, molecular docking, molecular dynamic simulation, FT-IR and (1)H NMR spectroscopy. CD spectroscopy, thermal denaturation and viscosity measurement explained that thalidomide is groove binder. Molecular docking analysis highlighted that thalidomide binds trough minor groove of calf thymus DNA which also confirmed from dye displacement experiment. To our knowledge, this is the first instance thalidomide was shown to binds with calf thymus DNA. Molecular dynamic simulation indicated that the thalidomide-DNA system was stabilized by electrostatic attraction as the main interaction and mode of binding is minor groove. Our study provides a better understanding to the DNA-thalidomide binding affinity and it mechanism. Overall, all these in formations can be used for further understanding the pharmacological effects of thalidomide.
abstract_zh: 沙利度胺与DNA的相互作用已通过多种生物物理技术进行了详细研究，包括紫外-可见光谱（UV-vis）、染料置换实验、粘度测定、循环伏安法、圆二色谱（CD）、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）及核磁共振氢谱（(1)H NMR）。CD光谱、热变性及粘度测量表明，沙利度胺是一种沟槽结合剂。分子对接分析强调，沙利度胺通过小沟结合于小牛胸腺DNA，这一结果也得到了染料置换实验的证实。据我们所知，这是首次证明沙利度胺与小牛胸腺DNA结合的研究。分子动力学模拟表明，沙利度胺-DNA系统主要通过静电吸引稳定，且结合模式为小沟结合。我们的研究为理解DNA-沙利度胺结合亲和力及其机制提供了更深入的认识。总体而言，这些信息可用于进一步理解沙利度胺的药理效应。
